The '''Gungan tree sloth''' was a [[Species/Legends|creature]] that, according to [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], was faster than an [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid]]. It shared its name with the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species<ref name="RepublicCommando" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan tree sloth was mentioned in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', which was developed and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="RepublicCommando" />
